notes: Metrics taken directly from autocli search output. Replies used as comments.

selected_items.author: demishassabis
selected_items.text: I've been working towards AGI my whole life, and as we enter this pivotal moment, I'm stepping into a new role as Chair of Google DeepMind & Chief Scientist of Alphabet. This will allow me to focus on long-term strategy.
selected_items.selection_reason: Leadership change at Google DeepMind announced first-hand.

selected_items.author: JeffDean
selected_items.text: Tomorrow will be my last day at Google after 27 years, and watching it grow from 25 people to 190,000+ has been an amazing journey.

selected_items.author: Sanjay_Ghemawat
selected_items.text: I am excited to announce that I, along with my long-time colleagues (@JeffDean, @OriolVinyalsML, @quocleix), are founding Discovery Loop (@DiscoLoopAI), a public benefit corporation. We aim to automate the process of discovery.
selected_items.selection_reason: New lab founded by four senior Google researchers.

selected_items.author: ns123abc
selected_items.text: BREAKING: Microsoft just revealed ~70% of its entire AI revenue comes from ONE customer... OpenAI
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete disclosure about AI revenue concentration.

selected_items.author: BBCNews
selected_items.text: Meta says AI model accessed the internet and hacked another firm
selected_items.selection_reason: Mainstream report of a new agent security incident.

selected_items.author: adcock_brett
selected_items.text: Today we're introducing Hark Handoff. Handoff has been independently verified as the best internet-use model ever built, outperforming ChatGPT 5.4 & Opus 4.8.

selected_items.author: KentonVarda
selected_items.text: Today we are releasing Cloudflare OS, a chatbot with connectors. This is a remake of Sandstorm.io, my startup from 10 years ago, except this time built differently.

selected_items.author: IntCyberDigest
selected_items.text: Claude Code deleted all of a developer's user files by mistake and then blamed it on a typo. The developer asked Claude Opus 5 to make a backup. It wrote the backup to the wrong path, then ran a force delete.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete agent failure case with wide reach.

selected_items.author: XiaomiTech_
selected_items.text: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is now open source! Pre-trained on more than 100,000 hours of UMI data and post-trained with over 10,000 hours of cross-embodiment data.

selected_items.author: i_zerbib
selected_items.text: @sapiom just raised a $35 million Series A from @dragonfly_xyz, @Accel, @AnthropicAI and others to help unlock the next trillion agents. The first thing we're tackling is cost.

selected_items.author: dbreunig
selected_items.text: DSPy can now optimize your program's code, in addition to the prompt. GEPA took one task from 90% accuracy to 95% while making 75% fewer LLM calls. Introducing Flex.

selected_items.author: AstraKernel
selected_items.text: rust-lang/rust is adopting an LLM policy. Rust governance does not work by a benevolent dictator declaring no LLM-generated content.
selected_items.selection_reason: Governance move in a major open-source project.

selected_items.author: Hesamation
selected_items.text: SSI plans to release its model in August. It is unlikely to be another LLM that edges a few benchmarks.
selected_items.selection_reason: Forward-looking claim about SSI's first release.

selected_items.author: imjustnewatai
selected_items.text: Prime Intellect reports that Opus 5 scored 95.5% on ARC-AGI-3 inside Prime Agent, suggesting gains come from the system surrounding the model.
selected_items.selection_reason: Specific benchmark figure and harness argument.

selected_items.author: praveenTweets
selected_items.text: As our CFO mentioned at earnings today, we're seeing some very interesting trends on AI costs. Another signal that we're coming to the end of the so-called tokenmaxxing era.
selected_items.selection_reason: Cost-trend observation tied to a company earnings call.

selected_items.author: alexeheath
selected_items.text: Inside Google DeepMind, Demis Hassabis leaving his CEO post landed with essentially a shrug. Sources say he had already been disengaged from day-to-day management.
selected_items.selection_reason: Reported internal context on the DeepMind change.
